title: Cross-Repo Architecture and Security Review Gate

architecture_scorecard.finding: The public GitHub Pages repo acts as a non-authoritative UI and evidence surface; protected mutation, provider keys, owner-scoped storage and cloud runtime policy stay behind private repos or backend routes.
architecture_scorecard.next_action: Keep public-safety audit in both deploy and quality workflows.

architecture_scorecard.finding: Correction remediation, execution, rollback, provider routing and paid compute paths remain gated by backend policy, explicit approval or no-spend blocks.
architecture_scorecard.next_action: Continue adding backend-only gates before any new source mutation, tunnel exposure or paid route.

architecture_scorecard.finding: Current public, backend, local-node and infra-template checks keep paid routes disabled unless explicitly approved; free/local/browser/mock routes are the default path.
architecture_scorecard.next_action: Make every new user journey show a free first action before paid/provider options.

architecture_scorecard.finding: Public and backend route manifests both pass independently, and local-node conformance is green; the platform still needs one merged drift report across frontend, local node, managed API and infra templates.
architecture_scorecard.next_action: Add a dedicated route parity check after the next Open WebUI-style chat polish slice.

architecture_scorecard.finding: Deterministic fixtures cover desktop/mobile selectors and no-overlap contracts, but live in-app browser automation was unstable in this thread.
architecture_scorecard.next_action: Prefer fixture gates now; restore live browser screenshot checks when the browser bridge is stable.

architecture_scorecard.finding: Backlog IDs, progress dashboard evidence, review reports and smoke gates give future agents a stable queue and guardrails across public, backend, local node and infra repos.
architecture_scorecard.next_action: Keep each new slice tied to one backlog ID, one verification path and one public-safe status update.

code_review_findings.finding: No high-severity secret leakage or public authority regression was found in the latest public/backend/local-node review pass.
code_review_findings.next_action: Keep public repo public-safe; do not place backend secrets, provider keys, tunnel secrets or paid route credentials in GitHub Pages.

code_review_findings.finding: Backend remediation gates enforce explicit confirmation, owner scope and rollback metadata before supported source changes.
code_review_findings.next_action: Continue using backend-only execution and rollback routes for source mutation.

code_review_findings.finding: OpenAI-compatible /v1 aliases were advertised by the public manifest but not implemented in the local node or managed backend runtime routes.
code_review_findings.next_action: Keep v1 alias checks in conformance and route manifests before adding more Open WebUI-compatible adapters.

code_review_findings.finding: The first-use flow is covered by many individual gates, but real browser/device QA still needs to prove it feels as smooth as ChatGPT/Open WebUI under normal user interaction.
code_review_findings.next_action: Continue D254 chat polish and restore live browser QA when the in-app browser bridge is stable.

code_review_findings.finding: Live browser screenshot QA could not be trusted in this thread because the in-app browser bridge timed out; deterministic fixture QA is green but not a full visual replacement.
code_review_findings.next_action: Keep fixture QA mandatory and reintroduce live screenshot checks once the browser bridge is reliable.

code_review_findings.finding: OCI and AWS runtime templates parse, but no cloud runtime has been provisioned or tested because no-spend mode is active.
code_review_findings.next_action: Keep cloud runtime work as template-only until explicit cost approval; focus on local/free activation first.

security_review.zero_trust_summary: Public UI stays non-authoritative, session/provider secrets are not stored in public localStorage, paid routes are blocked by policy unless explicitly approved, local node pairing protects local runtime access and backend routes enforce owner scope.
must_not_do: Do not make inkognitroz.github.io private while it is the GitHub Pages source unless deployment is moved.
Do not store provider API keys, cloud credentials or pairing tokens in public assets.
Do not let public JavaScript execute source mutation, rollback, paid provider, tunnel or cloud-provisioning routes without protected backend confirmation.
Do not provision OCI/AWS/GPU/paid model routes while no-spend mode is active.

ux_review.best_current_path: Free-first activation with MMIR Guide/browser helper fallback, guided local connector repair, model picker handoff, first chat receipt and Progress Dashboard evidence.
ux_review.main_gap: The parts are present and locally verified, but real browser/device QA still needs to prove the first impression is smooth, fast and obvious for a normal visitor.

next.label: Open WebUI / ChatGPT smooth chat polish
next.why: The review gate is green enough to continue product work; the remaining launch-critical risk is real-user smoothness of the chat-first flow.
